reviews.comment:
Muy malo servicio del ACA. Dicen que lavan por orden de llegada y empiezan a hacerlo a las 9 de la mañana. Pero aunque dejes tu auto a las 5 de la mañana y te digan que no hay ninguno adelante tuyo, cuando vas a buscar tu auto, están lavando otros adelante de tu turno.  No se si lavan a los  "amigos" o es solo una gran desorganización. 3 dias seguidos quedé sin poder lavarlo.

(Translated by Google)
The ACA service is terrible. They say they wash cars on a first-come, first-served basis and start at 9:00 AM. But even if you drop your car off at 5:00 AM and they tell you there's no one ahead of you, when you go to get your car, they're washing others ahead of you. I don't know if they're washing their "friends" or if it's just a huge mess. I couldn't get my car washed for three days straight.
